name: Ca nuong up chau
summary: Fish cooked by the heat of an upturned basin rather than an open flame, a family dish for the first days of the lunar year. The skin comes out golden and crisp-chewy, and the flesh firm and sweet.
origin: Nam Định. VnExpress, 18 March 2016, and Dân trí, 4 March 2017, for the home table. Trực Ninh on the 25 November 2022 OCOP list.
texture: When it is done, the skin is golden and crisp-chewy, and the flesh is firm and sweet.
howToEat: At the family table in the first days of the lunar year.
where: A Nam Định home on the 2016 and 2017 accounts, and Trực Ninh on the OCOP list.
seoTitle: Ca nuong up chau — fish under a basin
seoDescription: Fish grilled under an upturned basin at Tết, with golden, crisp-chewy skin and firm, sweet flesh.
